title: Quaddicted
wikitext:
A website dedicated to Quake Singleplayer maps, mods and news. After about half a year enthusiastically running a "Quakeblog" with news, [[Spirit]] launched Quaddicted.com at the 17th March 2005. What was first meant as universal Quake news page then emerged into an archive of singleplayer maps and mods.

[http://www.quaddicted.com official website]
